name: valuables
description: Portable wealth, trade goods, status objects, and collectibles

fields.name: Coin Purse
fields.description: Local currency mixing common small coins with harder-to-spend foreign money.

fields.name: Precious Jewel
fields.description: An identifiable piece of jewelry, portable but risky to resell.

fields.name: Work of Art
fields.description: A painting, sculpture, or decoration with recognizable cultural value.

fields.name: Ceremonial Clothing
fields.description: A robe, cloak, boots, or gloves associated with a rank or institution.

fields.name: Unfinished Crown
fields.description: A symbol of authority missing a gem, inscription, or essential piece.

fields.name: Ornate Comb
fields.description: A personal item decorated with a discreet crest or intimate inscription.

fields.name: Collectible Figurine
fields.description: One piece of a sought-after series, trivial alone but valuable to the right person.

fields.name: Gemstone
fields.description: A cut or rough stone whose value depends on quality and local demand.

fields.name: Antique coins
fields.description: Old coins valued more by collectors than their face value.

fields.name: Decorated silverware
fields.description: A small matched set marked with an identifiable pattern or crest.

fields.name: Luxury fabric
fields.description: A compact bolt of fine cloth suitable for trade or ceremonial clothing.

fields.name: Small sculpture
fields.description: A portable work whose maker, subject, or material gives it value.

fields.name: Rare book
fields.description: A complete and collectible volume sought by specialists.

fields.name: Ceremonial jewelry
fields.description: Ornaments associated with rank, office, or a formal tradition.

fields.name: Valuable trade goods
